note: Every claim carries its source and hash. A claim whose status is not VERIFIED or MEASURED may not appear in the narration. No number here comes from a document alone; each was re-derived on main at 97a02f6.

claims.spoken_as: 这条视频，二十一项检查全过。
claims.statement: The rejected cut passed 21 automated checks with 0 fail and 0 warn.
claims.usage_scope: technical checks only, for this one run
claims.caveat: Does not mean visual, aesthetic, voice-naturalness or factual quality passed. Those are the reasons it was rejected.

claims.statement: The graded artifact is 62.0 s, 1080x1920, six shots, all with motion: static.

claims.spoken_as: 实测六十二秒里，六十秒是静止的。
claims.statement: 60.10 s of the 62.0 s (96.9%) is near-static, across 12 freeze runs.
claims.usage_scope: this 62 s artifact, under these exact freeze parameters
claims.caveat: Must not be generalised to other Easel videos, to this repository, or to AI video in general. The number depends on the freezedetect thresholds.

claims.spoken_as: 没有一项在问：画面到底动没动。
claims.statement: scripts/qc_video.py contains no freeze or motion measurement.
claims.method: grep for freezedetect / freeze / motion returns 0 matches; the 24 check ids are existence, size, ffprobe, resolution, aspect, duration, codec, audio, project.yaml, source_refs, captions, script, storyboard, real-source ratio, provenance, engine, silence, subtitle burn, real evidence, voice quality
claims.usage_scope: states what the current implementation measures, not what all QC could measure
claims.caveat: Saying 'no check measures motion' is about this file today. It is not a claim that motion cannot be measured.

claims.spoken_as: 六个动效工程一直在仓库里，重新渲出来，和原片几乎看不出差别。
claims.statement: Six HyperFrames compositions re-render from source with visual equivalence to the committed clips.
claims.usage_scope: demonstrates that the compositions regenerate; not evidence about the rejected video's content
claims.caveat: Visual equivalence, not byte reproduction. The renderer version differs from the pin, so this is stated as equivalence and never as 'identical'.

claims.spoken_as: 是我们把质检通过，当成了可以发布。
claims.statement: The Founder rejected the cut on picture, motion, style and voice, while automated QC passed.
claims.usage_scope: the recorded reason for this rejection
claims.caveat: The rejection is qualitative; scores are null. Quote it as a decision, not as a measured score.

claims.spoken_as: 你觉得，AI 视频最容易露馅的，是画面还是配音？
claims.statement: A question to the audience. Not a factual claim.

excluded.reason: Belongs to a different artifact (easel-1024-proof); its QC receipt could not be read from the current remote. Not verifiable today, so it stays out of the script.

excluded.item: 7 doctor checks, 982/982 blob verification, 114 skill directories
excluded.reason: True but not the subject of this film, and each needs a same-day measurement and a stated denominator before use.
